_comment: Confirmed via live SDL2 capture on 2026-10-08. Button indices are 0-indexed pygame/SDL indices from the X45's own numbering, not vJoy's (vJoy buttons are 1-indexed virtual outputs).

mode_switch_buttons._comment: 3-way Mode switch (M1/M2/M3). Exactly one is held down at a time. Selects which layer of the layered_buttons below is active.

aux_slider_buttons._comment: 3-position Aux slider. Combined with Mode to pick 1 of 9 layers (3 mode x 3 aux), same idea the old SST .pr0 used, but done in software with real vJoy buttons instead of console macros.

disabled_buttons._comment: Physical 18-25 (throttle hat + mouse hat). Throttle hat confirmed dead (2026-10-08): nothing registers in SDL2 OR the Windows/Saitek DirectInput test panel -- almost certainly a real electrical fault inside the throttle unit, not a driver/API gap. Exact split between 'throttle hat' vs 'mouse hat' within 18-25 was never verified live since nothing fired. Leave disabled until the throttle unit is repaired and someone re-captures which indices actually move.

axes._comment: 6 analog axes confirmed working (stick X/Y, throttle, rudder, 2 rotary knobs), but which pygame axis index (0-5) is which physical control was NOT recorded. Run 'python src/remapper.py --calibrate-axes' and move one control at a time to find out, then fill in axis_order below with the physical names in pygame-axis-index order. Until then axes just pass through 0->X, 1->Y, 2->Z, 3->RX, 4->RY, 5->RZ blindly, which is fine for first boot but may need swapping.

pov1._comment: Main hat switch, passed straight through to vJoy continuous POV #1.
